title: FlexLine Draw Fee: Draw-Size Points
content:
**Tariff note — FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit.** For a back-billed draw fee, the draw-size points are taken off the tier's draw fee percent by the draw measured against the credit limit, so a larger draw billed late carries a smaller surprise: a draw of more than 25% of the credit limit takes off 0.25 percentage points; a draw of more than 5% and no more than 25% of it takes off 0.10 percentage points; a draw of 5% of the credit limit or less takes off nothing.

The draw is the draw being billed; the credit limit is the line's credit limit on the booking date. The points come off the percent before the fee is figured on the draw.

| Draw against the credit limit | Percentage points taken off |
|---|---|
| more than 25% | 0.25 |
| more than 5%, up to and including 25% | 0.10 |
| 5% or less | none |

*Hypothetical boundary figures on a 6000.00 USD limit:* a 1500.00 USD draw is exactly 25% and takes off 0.10; 1500.01 USD takes off 0.25; a 300.00 USD draw is exactly 5% and takes off nothing; on FlexLine Plus (2.0%) a 0.25-point reduction leaves 1.75%.
